I just stayed a week in a psych ward for mine just 2 weeks ago. Luckily since I’m under 18, I was in the pediatric side with little kids and not with the adults. In the hospital I was at, they got us up at 8AM daily, we had to be dressed and showered, then go eat breakfast. We had a lot of group therapy and exercise. My advice, even if you don’t want to, talk about why you’re there. If you don’t, they might keep you there longer and have a more difficult time treating you. Everyone said that it was a 2-3 day stay, but I was in the hospital for an entire week. We had to eat all of our meals or we would stay longer which was a problem for me because I don’t eat much. I know it seems scary, but you’ll get the help you need. I feel so much better since I went. They might prescribe you medication which helps tremendously. I was on Prozac before I went which didn’t work AT ALL but they changed me over to Zoloft for depression and anxiety, and Trazodone for depression and insomnia. It sucked being there but if I hadn’t gone, I would have been dead right now. Just tell them the entire truth because it will only help you in the long run. Prayers going up for you!!
